def solve(case):
    items = case['items']
    required = set(case['required_failure_items'])
    unresolved_without = set(case['unresolved_without'])
    
    def test(subset):
        s = set(subset)
        # unresolved check: if any unresolved_without missing -> UNRESOLVED
        for u in unresolved_without:
            if u not in s:
                return 'UNRESOLVED'
        # failure check: if all required present -> FAIL
        for r in required:
            if r not in s:
                return 'PASS'
        return 'FAIL'
    
    # initial test
    current = list(items)
    tests = 1
    out = test(current)
    if out != 'FAIL':
        raise ValueError("Initial configuration must produce FAIL")
    
    n = 2
    while len(current) > 1:
        reduced = False
        # partition into n intervals
        length = len(current)
        for i in range(n):
            start = i * length // n
            end = (i + 1) * length // n
            subset = current[start:end]
            out = test(subset)
            tests += 1
            if out == 'FAIL':
                current = subset
                reduced = True
                break
            # test complement
            complement = current[:start] + current[end:]
            out = test(complement)
            tests += 1
            if out == 'FAIL':
                current = complement
                reduced = True
                break
        if reduced:
            n = 2  # decrease granularity
        else:
            n = min(2 * n, length)
            if n == length:
                # no further reduction possible (all singletons tested)
                break
    # final outcome is FAIL
    return {
        "minimal_failure": current,
        "tests": tests,
        "outcome": "FAIL"
    }
